Hi Tessa / Ben,

Quick context: we expect a very concentrated preview sale on Nov 20–22 where traffic will spike ~6x baseline for ~36 hours. Our infra team would prefer not to re-architect; instead we want a short-window capacity plan with clear economics. Two things we need from Redwood: 1) a short-window burst/true-up option that avoids punitive overage rates and 2) a simple addendum/PO flow so procurement can sign quickly.

Can you send:
- Pricing for a provisional headroom (prepaid token block usable only during the window) — sizes: 250k / 500k tokens.
- Pricing for an on-demand overrun path with a capped per-token surcharge and a clear reconciliation/true-up.
- Any limited-time credits or discounts you can offer for committing to a modest bump in monthly committed spend (we can consider a one-month uplift).

Attached is a usage snapshot and our projected hourly curve. We need a papered solution that legal/procurement can sign in a week.

Thanks,
Diane

Hi Diane — thanks for the details and the snapshot (looks like a tight peak). Putting options below — keeping the language intentionally concise so procurement can pick. Laura is looped for PO and billing cadence.

Option A — Provisional headroom (prepay / reserved for window)
- 250k tokens: $2,250 flat (equivalent blended token rate = $0.009)
- 500k tokens: $4,000 flat (blended = $0.008)
- Unused tokens expire 14 days after window close; can be applied to subsequent month with written approval.

Option B — On-demand overrun (true-up capped surcharge)
- Base: normal per-token rate applies until committed cap reached.
- Overrun surcharge: +35% per-token above commit for the 48-hour window, capped at a hard ceiling (we will not exceed $0.015/token).
- True-up: monthly reconciliation; overrun reported in next invoice cycle.

Promotional/Contractual concession (short-term)
- If BrightCart agrees to a one-month committed uplift (min +20% monthly commit) and signs the attached addendum by 2026-08-10, we can: 1) reduce provisional headroom pricing by 15% (Option A) OR 2) cap the on-demand overrun surcharge at +20% (Option B).
- Additionally, we can provide a $5k one-time credit to offset any invoice timing mismatch for the window.

Attached: Draft-Addendum-BrightCart-v1.docx (contains formal language for the short-window headroom and the temporary surcharge cap). Laura — can you confirm PO acceptance flow and whether the $5k credit needs separate approval?

Let me know which option you prefer and I’ll route to legal for a quick sign-off.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan

Diane — quick follow from pricing ops. Appreciate Tessa’s clear options. Two tactical tweaks that might help BrightCart move faster: 

1) Blended short-window true-up (recommended)
- We create a temporary blended bucket for the 48-hour window: if overrun occurs, usage is billed at a blended rate equal to (commit rate * 0.8) + (overrun rate * 0.2) up to the hard ceiling. Practically this smooths the effective per-token cost and avoids a shock invoice.

2) Time-limited signature incentive
- Sign addendum by 2026-08-09 => additional 5% off the provisional headroom price OR lock the on-demand surcharge cap at +15%.

Operational notes: please include PO number in the DocuSign signing request so we can match invoices immediately. If you prefer the provisional headroom, we’ll allocate a named token block to your account and open a temporary quota that automatically expires on 2026-11-25.

If that sounds good I can have a final SOW/addendum ready in a day.

—Ben
Ben Carter
